data.description: A data property that contains an array of resource items. Each entry in the array is a separate resource.

ListMeta.description: ListMeta describes metadata that resource collections may have

first.description: A link to the first page of results. If a response does not contain a first link, then direct navigation to the first page is not supported.

last.description: A link to the last page of results. If a response does not contain a last link, then direct navigation to the last page is not supported.

prev.description: A link to the previous page of results. If a response does not contain a prev link, then either there is no previous data or backwards traversal through the result set is not supported.

next.description: A link to the next page of results. If a response does not contain a next link, then there is no more data available.

total_size.description: Number of records in the full result set. This response may be paginated and have a smaller number of records.

ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is metadata that all persisted resources must have, which includes all objects users must create.

self.description: Self is a Uniform Resource Locator (URL) at which an object can be addressed. This URL encodes the service location, API version, and other particulars necessary to locate the resource at a point in time

resource_name.description: Resource Name is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) that is globally unique across space and time. It is represented as a Confluent Resource Name

created_at.description: The date and time at which this object was created. It is represented in RFC3339 format and is in UTC.

updated_at.description: The date and time at which this object was last updated. It is represented in RFC3339 format and is in UTC.

deleted_at.description: The date and time at which this object was (or will be) deleted. It is represented in RFC3339 format and is in UTC.

api_version.description: APIVersion defines the schema version of this representation of a resource.

kind.description: Kind defines the object this REST resource represents.

name.description: The user-provided name of the agent, unique within this environment.

organization_id.description: The unique identifier for the organization.

environment_id.description: The unique identifier for the environment.

model.description: The name of the model the agent uses for inferencing.

prompt.description: The instruction prompt that guides the agent's behavior.

tools.description: The list of tools available to the agent.

properties.description: A set of key-value option pairs that configure the agent's behavior.
